title: rollinia mucosa var. neglecta
intro: Rollinia mucosa var. neglecta, commonly known as the Amazonian biriba, is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Rollinia mucosa var. neglecta include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, making it a valuable natural remedy for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
